applicant.name: Dr. Johanna Kofler
applicant.organisation: Fachhochschule Krems, Department of Health Sciences (respiratory care programme)

purpose: For our respiratory nursing curriculum we want to describe how inhaled maintenance therapy for asthma is used in children, working-age adults and older people, and compare it with the stepwise treatment guideline.
question: Please provide pseudonymised records of all patients with asthma together with their prescriptions.
definitions: Asthma = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J45.
ICS/LABA combination = ATC code starting with R03AK; long-acting muscarinic antagonist (LAMA) = ATC code starting with R03BB.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per band: patients with asthma, % with an active ICS/LABA combination and % with an active LAMA, one decimal.
